reviewed_by: Claude Code (deployer change for a two-step rollout the user asked for)
reason: Adds `prepare --commit <sha>` to the simulation deployer so a release adding stored-entity fields can roll out after the first tolerant commit. Selected for that: test_runtime_host_services.py (the host-services listener whose attributes were typed) and test_memory_api.py (the memory-budget routes the supervisor forwards).
exclusions: No Core, UI, setting or chat journey changed, so no frontend, Playwright or LAN-instance journey applies. promote, cycle and prebuild are unchanged (promote deploys whatever prepare recorded as pending). main_commit was also exercised against real git: 924ba13 resolves; PR-branch commits 1c80b2b and 61628bc are refused. Locally test_host_synchronizes_current_product_guidance_and_preserves_it_on_restart and test_guidance_mirror_failure_is_reported_while_packaged_help_remains_available fail identically on pristine origin/main in a fresh checkout (missing generated product_knowledge.sqlite3.b85).
